_meta._note: Krok 1: minimalna struktura. Wszystkie klucze muszą być symetryczne z pl/common.json.

no_role.title: Account without a role
no_role.body: This account does not have a role assigned. Please contact the admin.
no_role.recovery_hint: If you want to sign in with a different account, sign out and go to the login page.
no_role.sign_out_btn: Sign out and go to login

no_company.title: Account without an assigned company
no_company.body: Your registration did not complete fully and the account has no company assigned. Fastest fix: register again with the same email address — the system will repair the account automatically. You can also contact the admin.

no_retailer.title: Account without an assigned retailer
no_retailer.body: This buyer account does not have a retail chain assigned. Please contact the admin to connect the profile with the correct retail chain.

config_error.title: Supabase configuration missing
config_error.body: The .env file does not have VITE_SUPABASE_URL or VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY set.
config_error.step_2: Paste the keys from Supabase dashboard (Project Settings → API)

uploader.hint_full: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF · max 5 MB · up to {{max}} photos

errors.no_company_id: Missing company_id in profile — please contact the admin.
errors.no_offer_id: Missing offerId — save the offer first, then add photos.
errors.limit_reached: Limit of {{max}} photos — remove old ones before adding new.
errors.file_too_large: File “{{file}}” is too large ({{size}} MB). The maximum size is {{max}} MB — please compress it (e.g. PDF at ilovepdf.com) and try again.
